pages.title: Illager Honor
pages.text: A $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Savage Essence$() grants Illager Honor, the middle alliance effect. Illagers stop treating you as prey, and it does not wear off on its own.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: It carries 10 recruitment slots by default. Hurting an Illager-side creature is survivable here; killing one ends the pact.$(br2)Bad Omen suppresses it while it lasts, and Illager Honor comes back when Bad Omen goes.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: Any Raidborn alliance effect costs you the village side of the game: Villagers will not deal with you, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village stays out of reach while it lasts.
